handoff.note: ledger.mjs --self --waves <file>, at a wave boundary only: the orchestrator's last context minus a fresh session's, times the last wave's turns, as cache reads. Each decision is logged in run.md as the handoff-decision line that --self prints; the retro reads them back with ledger.mjs --handoffs <run.md> --next <the next session-dir> and recalibrates. freshSessionTokens: resumed sessions averaged 72k, 135k, 193k, 73k and 153k context over their first turns; 135k, the median, kept. minimumUnitsSaved (a quarter of a percent of the week) kept: the two logged yes decisions predicted 15.7M and 19.1M saved and the next sessions showed 13.6M and 10.0M, so the prediction runs up to 1.9x high but both cleared the threshold four times over.

unitTargetNote: Yardsticks, not caps: no agent can see its own usage, so a target changes nothing while the agent runs. The ledger flags an agent past its target for the retro to explain. A retro resets each target to the role's p90 by model (ledger.mjs <session-dir> --percentiles), unless the epic was an outlier in units per PR, when a target is kept so the next epic's warnings still fire. Reset 2026-11-11: fix sonnet n 40, p90 0.70M and 0.64M in two sessions; review-new-logic opus n 12, p90 1.4M. Kept: builder sonnet (n 40, p90 3.5M, in an epic at 2.3x the highest earlier units per PR), builder opus (n 1), review-small (n 31, p90 0.18M), sharpen (n 3), critical read, walk, mechanical and orchestrator. Checked 2026-11-11 after an epic at 1.7M units per PR, the lowest in the history: builder sonnet n 7, p90 1.1M, equals its target; fix sonnet (n 6, p90 0.48M), review-small (n 6, 0.10M), review-new-logic opus (n 3, 0.66M) and walk (n 1, 0.74M) came in under target in a low outlier, so every target kept. Checked 2026-11-13 after an epic at 7.2M agent units per merged PR (50.7M over 7; a high outlier, second in the history): builder sonnet n 6, p90 3.6M; fix sonnet n 6, p90 1.2M; review-small n 6, p90 0.33M; review-new-logic opus n 6, p90 2.5M; builder opus n 1, 12.2M; fix opus n 1, 4.5M; walk n 1, 0.98M. Every target kept, as the outlier rule says: the overruns were one oversized step (a format, its migration and its writers in one builder), not the targets.

defaultLocal.note: What a description key the table lacks costs the machine: heavy roles run builds and tests, light roles read files and wait on the model. scripts/lib/machine.mjs reads this and each role's local; an unknown key counts light.

builder.note: opus only where the critical read names the step design-heavy; haiku only where it names the step one simple edit repeated across many files, and that step's reviewer compares each file against the text it replaced (one epic: nine README blocks, 0.25M units against a 0.96M sonnet median, 4 of 9 lost existing text and the review caught all 4)

fix.note: always a fresh agent, at most 10 findings

sharpen.note: the one agent the cap hook lets past the caps (description key `sharpen:`): builds the tool or fixes the brief that the top sink of ledger.mjs --time points at; the target is a guess until a retro sets it
